author: Carnival-Freak
body:
As mentioned, you need to walk around and look for green areas (in-game forests) on the world map, and even then he's still a rarer spawn. You can use affinity and seeker's candles to increase your odds.

Alternatively, you can do regular mob dungeons (horde might be easier at tier 7/8 than endless), where he also has a chance of showing up.
